headline: Oura postpones $2.2B IPO citing market uncertainty
summary: Smart-ring maker Oura postponed its planned $2.2 billion IPO, citing market uncertainty even though it said demand remained strong. The delay will push back plans for IPO proceeds for both the company and its shareholders, as the broader IPO market cooled in the third quarter after a solid start to the year.
